text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fan mail had arrived for Yaeno Muteki, so
I handed it to her when we crossed paths on academy grounds.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"This is truly the sincere heartfelt feelings of everyone cheering me on.
I must straighten my collar and read every word with solemn respect."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a serious expression, Yaeno Muteki unsealed
the letter and began reading, but...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOOOOOO!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Out of nowhere, Yaeno Muteki let out a roar...
and sprinted off!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following Yaeno Muteki led me to the rooftop.
There, driven by raw passion,
she was unleashing a fierce flurry of punches.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Haaah!! Seiiiyaaa!!
Doryaaaaaaaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
choice_data_list: Could something terrible be written in the letter...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Far from it...!
If anything, quite the opposite!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: The sender was... a fellow disciple of the Kongo Yaegaki style.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...It was at my master's urging that I stepped onto the path of racing.
However, naturally, there were peers who could not accept that."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Fellow Disciple
text_block_list.text:
“—Why!? You said we'd work hard
at martial arts together! Yae-chan, you liar!”

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"……It is a fact that I broke my vow to my friend back home.
I have disciplined myself and faced my daily training
so that I would never, ever forget that."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: However... this letter that arrived today says—

text_block_list.name: Letter from a Fellow Disciple
text_block_list.text:
"...'I was angry all along.
Because I thought you were the only one who ran away from martial arts, leaving me behind, Yae-chan.'"

text_block_list.name: Letter from a Fellow Disciple
text_block_list.text:
"However, seeing Yae-chan running on TV
made me realize. Yae-chan is still
nobly walking her 'path' even now."

text_block_list.name: Letter from a Fellow Disciple
text_block_list.text:
"...The assistant instructor used to say it too, right?
'It's not enough to simply not turn away those who come, nor chase those who leave.
Welcome those who come, and see off those who leave.'"

text_block_list.name: Letter from a Fellow Disciple
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sorry for the terrible things I said back then.
It's a bit late now, but... please let me see Yae-chan off too." ...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Words cannot express what I feel right now.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"My feelings, ride the wind from my fist, race through the heavens,
and reach my friend's side!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Upon receiving a letter from an old acquaintance, Yaeno Muteki reaffirmed her vow to continue striving relentlessly along the "Way of Racing."
